Britton Tower Closure T T T Alerts Current Conditions Events Passes Recreation Safety and Outdoor Ethics Visitor Maps and Guides Mt. Britton Tower Closure The uppermost section of the Mt. Britton Trail that leads to the Mt. Britton tower will be closed. The Mt. Britton trailhead can still be used to access the structure at El Yunque Peak during the closure. Cierre de la Torre del Monte Britton El segmento superior de la vereda Monte Britton que conduce a la torre estará cerrada. Los visitantes aún podrán utilizar el inicio de la vereda del Monte Britton para acceder a la Torre del Pico El Yunque durante el cierre.
